description: Third Party Data Sources is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This dataset contains information from external sources that we believe may be of use to our Portal users. Each data source has been assigned to at least one theme to aid in filtering, and users can use this filter on the left of the page. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Net Zero Future, Connecting Generation, Connecting Demand. Its keywords are Gas and Third Party. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
